Description

The Casa de Mamá Portable Breast Milk Cooler is designed to safely store cold breast milk while you’re out of the house. With a large 650ml capacity that fits two 300ml bottles, a leak-proof lid and even, iceless 360° cooling, it keeps milk cold for up to 24 hours — perfect for days out, holidays and travelling. Two cooling cylinders are included: use them together to keep milk cold all day.

Key Product Features

Iceless 360° cooling

Keeps breast milk cold for up to 24 hours without needing any ice, so it’s ready whenever you are.

650ml capacity, fits two 300ml bottles

Room for two full 300ml bottles, so you can carry a whole day’s feeds in one bottle.

Leak-proof lid

A secure leak-proof lid keeps your milk safely inside and your bag dry, so you can pack it with everything else without a second thought.

Made for pumping mums.

Take your milk to work without the worry. It stays properly cold all day, so there’s no need to trust a shared office fridge, and its discreet design looks just like an everyday water bottle.

How it works

1Freeze

Pop the two cooling cylinders in the freezer for 12 hours, so they’re ready whenever you need them.

2Load

Slide the frozen cylinders into the cooler, ready to keep everything inside cold.

3Chill

Add your bottles and close the leak-proof lid. Your milk stays cold for up to 24 hours, wherever the day takes you.
